description: This file defines the feature for editing user profiles in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes data models, validation, and request handling logic for updating user information such as username, email, bio, image, and password.

classes.name: Edit.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object for capturing user profile fields to be updated.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Request object encapsulating the user data for editing, implementing IRequest for MediatR handling.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validation class ensuring that the Command contains non-null user data.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Request handler that performs the user profile update operation within the database context.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the update request, retrieves the current user, updates the user data, hashes the password if provided, and saves changes to the database.
